body:
Definitely not dead! In fact I believe the player base is growing pretty quickly. 
There’s a very lively community over on the discord and the dev Odie is adding new things every month. If the game feels dead for you, then definitely try joining a more active kingdom, or at least getting involved in the main discord.

author: SilasVale
body: Orna is in the best state it's ever been in. Odie, the dev, constantly has been putting out huge quality of life stuff recently, and there have been some massive hype instances in the discord over the past month. Orna is one of the games I've put the most time into full-stop, even including PC games, and I don't regret any of it. One of the best games I've ever played, and continue to play daily.
